title: Aureline M5 public-proof freshness ledger
description: Canonical per-domain public-proof freshness ledger for the public-proof ledger and the transparency report. Names the proof object, its supported line association, the freshness window it publishes, whether the current public-claim / compatibility-report / support-window proof and export-safe upstream-health/maintainer-durability report have been refreshed within that window, and its public-safe versus internal-only export class so external claims, partner reviews, and procurement checks inherit current rather than tribal truth and no internal-only incident or security detail leaks into a public-safe feed. Downstream release, help, docs, support, public-proof, and partner/procurement surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's public-proof and transparency posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
